_about: Public-domain James Milnor (1773-1844), evangelical Episcopal rector of St. George's, New York, for the Word Hoard: Plea for the American Colonization Society (1826) and the sermon on the death of DeWitt Clinton (1828), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 55 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

milnor-dewitt-clinton: Sermon occasioned by the death of His Excellency DeWitt Clinton, late governor of the State of New-York. Preached in St. George's church, N.Y., on Sunday, February 24, 1828 (New York : Printed by Gray and Bunce, 1828)
